quant.rule: PRODUCT_EXPERIMENT entry: eligible = status OK on BOTH boards AND pure_selection t >= 2 (full sample) on the basket fair twin AND on the sticky twin (TWIN_STICKY_v1). The book holds the eligible rules' current picks, equal weight ACROSS RULES (a name picked by several rules sums their shares, clipped at max_name_frac, never renormalised), graded against SPY and each rule's fair and sticky twins, labelled CANNOT_DISTINGUISH vs the market. A re-run board is read only at the monthly rebalance and its id is recorded on the decision. No eligible rule -> cash
quant.capital_candidate_gate: CAPITAL_CANDIDATE (promotion, never entry): net_minus_market t >= 2 in the validation window (2009-2016) AND matured forward evidence vs SPY and the twins, realistic costs, drawdown bounds; promotion stays attended
